policies.summary: Bonafide certificates for bus passes, passport verification, bank loans, and visa applications are issued within 2 business days.
policies.details: Students can request an electronic or physical bonafide certificate stating purpose, program, and year of study. E-bonafides with QR code digital signature are delivered directly to the student portal and email.
policies.actionable: Submit an online certificate request stating purpose and required quantity.

policies.summary: Official sealed academic transcripts for higher studies or international universities take 5 to 7 business days.
policies.details: Fee is ₹200 per copy. Transcripts include semester grade sheets, credit summaries, and CGPA conversion formulas, signed by the Controller of Examinations. Express courier delivery available upon request.
policies.actionable: Apply with student roll number, postal address, and purpose.

policies.topic: Duplicate Student ID Card and Smart Access Badge
policies.summary: Lost ID cards can be reissued after submitting a loss declaration and paying ₹250 replacement fee.
policies.details: Old smart card is deactivated within 1 hour to prevent unauthorized access. Temporary pass is provided at the Security Desk while the new smart RFID card is printed within 48 hours.
policies.actionable: File a lost ID request to Student Affairs to immediately deactivate the lost RFID tag.
